title: Compiler Descriptors
description: A list of compiler installations used to generate CMake user presets.

compiler.title: Compiler
compiler.description: A single compiler installation with its name, location, and executables.

name.title: Preset Name
name.description: Identifier used as the CMake preset name.

root.title: Installation Root
root.description: Absolute path to the compiler installation directory.

cc.title: C Compiler
cc.description: Name or relative path of the C compiler executable.

cxx.title: C++ Compiler
cxx.description: Name or relative path of the C++ compiler executable.

addPaths.title: Add to Environment Paths
addPaths.description: When true, adds the compiler's bin, lib, and include directories to PATH, LIBRARY_PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and CPATH.
